name: Zhang Lei
source:
He is the head of the HH brothers, the rival organization of the Red Flower Society, and is also an executive of the Web.
He became the head at a young age and has continued to walk the path of solitude as a lonely emperor.
He was a client of Yvet's at KTV, where Yvet used to work as a hostess.
He is the one who threw Lycoris into the Web, so he cares about Lycoris in some way.
The loss of Wolf, whom he considered a friend and not just a subordinate, casts a shadow over his mind, but he is basically ruthless.
He has a hobby of eating ghetto food.
After the attack on Francis, he joins forces with the Red Flower Society to fight against the police.
